item.title: City approves proposal for firefighter bunk rooms
item.description: Fenton — Fenton has begun the process to build four bunk rooms for firefighters at the Fenton Fire Department to accommodate overnight firefighter staffing in the future. On Monday, Feb. 2, the Fenton City Council approved a proposal in a 6-0 vote from Lindhout and Associates for $5,580 to create architectural drawings for the bunk rooms/sleeping quarters. item.description: Fenton — A former Fenton dispatcher is now the operations manager at Genesee County 9-1- 1, overseeing 911 operations for the county.
